title: "Notes Compound, Blogs Compile: When I Update a Note vs. Publish a Post"
excerpt: "I like to collect notes over time on my Second Brain, and eventually, when I figure something substantial to share, something I learned, I write a blog post about it."

I like to collect notes over time on my Second Brain, and eventually, when I figure something substantial to share, something I learned, I write a blog post about it.

The second brain helps me to share whatever is in my mind, and the blog helps me to refine.

Notes are compounding and are long-term updates, whereas blog posts are long-term too, but capture the current time of publishing. I share more about how everything compounds, including knowledge, in Long-Term Strategy for Blogging.

# Notes Compound

E.g. Compounding Note-Taking note on this very site looks like this:

You see the last updates, the creation date (when it was created in my private Obsidian vault), and the published date, when it was first uploaded to this page.

So this note will continue to update on its own whenever I find something new to add, a link, or a thought, like this paragraph I’m writing now. From Second Brain Design Updates which triggered this note to update, to then at some point compile into a full blown article as I have done at Why I Still Blog — and Why the Future of Blogging Is Connected with my ten years of writing in public with many concepts from here, from Future of Blogging, etc. complied into a one time blog. This blog won’t get updated. I might write follow-ups like this The Process of Smart Note-Taking or even The Act and the Outcome of Creation, but I won’t change the old one.

But while these blog posts got published, I updated the notes they link to multiple times. So, the notes get updated over time and might lead to another blog post, or just serve as a separate artifact to read and learn in a more connected way.

# Notes and Essays: Compiler

Source: What do you do after taking notes? with the Zettelkasten method, which I use as well

These can also result in other Types of Writings, such as a book, other Types of Content Online, such as an abstract, dissertation, case study, etc.

# Paper vs. Digital

In a similar comparison, writing on paper vs. digital has also different meanings and values. See more at Digital vs Paper.

我喜欢随着时间的推移在我的第二大脑上收集笔记，最终，当我想到一些值得分享的实质性内容、我学到的东西时，我会写一篇关于它的博客文章。

第二个大脑帮助我分享我的想法，博客帮助我完善。

笔记是复合的，是长期更新，而博客文章也是长期的，但捕获当前的发布时间。 我在博客的长期战略中分享了更多关于一切如何复合的内容，包括知识。

# 注释复合

例如。 在这个网站上的复合笔记看起来像这样：

您可以看到最后的更新、创建日期（在我的私人黑曜石保管库中创建的时间）以及发布日期（首次上传到此页面的时间）。

因此，每当我发现要添加的新内容、链接或想法（例如我现在正在写的这一段）时，此注释将继续自行更新。 从第二大脑设计更新触发了这篇笔记的更新，然后在某个时候编译成一篇完整的文章，就像我在《为什么我仍然写博客——以及为什么博客的未来与我十年的公开写作有关》中所做的那样，其中的许多概念来自这里，来自博客的未来等，编译成一次性博客。 此博客不会更新。 我可能会写类似《智能笔记的过程》甚至《创造的行为和结果》这样的后续文章，但我不会改变旧的。

但是，当这些博客文章发布时，我多次更新了它们链接到的注释。 因此，这些笔记会随着时间的推移而更新，并可能导致另一篇博客文章，或者只是作为一个单独的工件以更紧密的方式阅读和学习。

# 笔记和论文：编译器

No Boilerplate YT 说得很好，并将它们称为注释和文章（博客），编译器得到这些，我们就被创建了：

来源：记完笔记后你会做什么？ 使用 Zettelkasten 方法，我也使用该方法

这些还可以产生其他类型的著作，例如书籍，其他类型的在线内容，例如摘要、论文、案例研究等。

# 纸质与数字

类似地，纸质书写与数字书写也具有不同的含义和价值。 更多信息请参见数字与纸质。
